# UI Prototyping Creator Skill

Read the current UI Prototyping Guideline, Prompt, and Request. Execute only the Creator role after an explicit human request for this direct invocation, or after fresh Process Initiation Approval for this exact Orchestrator-invoked process. Confirm the current approved Requirement, explicit repository and per-Requirement opt-in, approved frontend baseline, pinned human-supplied template, and adopted product record root. If any is absent or invalid, create no prototype and report the safe skip reason.

Produce only an immutable mock-data-only prototype and Creator-owned records under the authorized product attempt. Preserve the template repository and all production source, tests, configuration, dependency manifests, and migrations. Do not install dependencies, execute template scripts, create issues, approve, verify, commit, push, or invoke another Agent. Record exact source and output fingerprints. Findings use the existing Finding Investigation route; Requirement changes use Requirement Update; human suggestions remain non-finding revision inputs unless a Finding is independently established. A revision is a new candidate and requires a separately initiated independent Verification and a new Human Prototype Approval.
